notes: Year-only ship. Encoded ONLY from Dettson's own page text; the sister listing is not used as reuse evidence. The page states month at 4th-5th characters, but its own example E072514528 gives 25 there, which is not a valid month, so no month is encoded. The value 25 would be week-plausible under the ICP year-week pattern, but the page labels it month, so no week is encoded either; month/week held pending clarification of the page text.

styles.notes: Page positions 2nd-3rd characters = year (1-based), converted to 0-based half-open [1,3]. Page positions 4th-5th characters give 25 on the page example, invalid as a month, so month is omitted (see file notes).
